## Activity

During January 2023, Oakridge Primary Care completed 62 captures. Activity was recorded against the site’s planned operations for the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no other operational issues identified in the information provided for this report.

The capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below. These results should be considered together when reviewing activity at Oakridge Primary Care.

## Image quality

Of the 62 captures completed, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.8 per cent. This indicates that most captures were available for grading, while a small proportion could not be assessed. The image-quality result should continue to be monitored through routine review of capture practice and session activity.

## Grading

There were 10 referable results among the captures graded during January 2023. The median grading lag was 2 days. This reflects the midpoint waiting time for grading and provides a summary measure of the timeliness of the grading process.

Overall, the report records 62 captures, 3 ungradable images, a rate of 4.8 per cent, and 10 referable results, with a median grading lag of 2 days.
